native_path_contract: Reverse and Combine preserve recursively owned operation trees and independent source lines; native version 9 po encoding roundtrips these operations.
Trim preserves signed length, shifted/clamped range and delegates lazy point ratios rather than flattening anchors.
Path Anchor preserves all six source numeric coordinates, including reflected controls when mirror is enabled.
Source operation getPointSegment is absent and remains a named unsupported path consumer boundary rather than fabricated segment geometry.

runtime_matrix_evidence.behavior: Native transform uses the official BuildMatrix coefficient order and negative Euler radians after source quaternion-to-Euler rounding. Degenerate perspective/orthographic divisions preserve the official identity guards. Desktop runtime equivalence remains unverified.

point_uv_contract: Pinned Surface_sampler rounds coordinates ties-even then clamps to edge; floating RGBA samples retain signed/HDR channels and single-channel floats enter packed-color getters. Native RGBA4/R8 are refused because that sampler does not define their formats.
matrix_eigen_contract: Retains source 1000-iteration, 1e-5 threshold, Rayleigh quotient and break-before-candidate assignment. Non-square matrices, zero-norm iteration and nonfinite geometry receive explicit native diagnostics. Native CPU order is capped at 32 to bound cubic work; this is a native limit, not a source restriction.
